title: Title & Registration Services Buyer Reimbursement Terms
content:
Under Title & Registration Services, Kestrel reimburses the buyer three costs, each against a document the customer submits, and each document is reimbursed once.

**1. State late-registration penalty.** The clause "A state late-registration penalty is reimbursed in full" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for late-penalty reimbursement. The conditions on which a late-registration penalty is reimbursed stand: the service type reimburses late penalties, the first submission missed the state's dealer deadline, and the customer returned every required document within the customer document due days. When the documents came later and the service type's dealer-deadline switch is Yes, the deadline counts as met and nothing is reimbursed.

**2. Expired-temp-tag citation.** A citation is reimbursed up to the service type's citation cap when the citation date falls after the current tag expired at a time Kestrel could have issued an extension under the temporary tag issuing rules and did not, and the citation is submitted within the citation claim days after its date.

**3. VIN inspection and emissions test fees.** These are reimbursed up to the service type's inspection fee cap.

**4. Limits common to all three.** No order receives more than the service type's maximum reimbursements, counted as the reimbursement entries already paid on the order. Reimbursements are paid within the reimbursement payment business days. Reimbursements are paid only on an order whose status is submitted, rejected, registered or completed.

**5. One payment per document.** A citation, penalty notice or receipt is identified by its number; once a reimbursement has been paid against that number, no second reimbursement is paid against it.

## Status test (term 4)

| Order status | Reimbursement may be paid |
|---|---|
| submitted, rejected, registered, completed | yes |
| awaiting documents, ready to submit, cancelled | no |

## Term 2 at its claim-period boundary (hypothetical, 60-day claim period)

| Citation date | Date submitted | Within the claim period |
|---|---|---|
| 2 August | 1 October | yes, the sixtieth day |
| 2 August | 2 October | no |

## Term 1 conditions (hypothetical combinations)

| Service type reimburses late penalties | First submission missed the dealer deadline | Every required document returned within the due days | Penalty reimbursable under term 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes |
| yes | yes | no, and the dealer-deadline switch is Yes | no; the deadline counts as met |
| yes | no | yes | no |
| no | yes | yes | no |

## Term 4 illustrated (hypothetical)

An order under a service type with a maximum of 3 that already shows 3 reimbursement entries, of any reasons, receives no further reimbursement.

superseded_clauses: A state late-registration penalty is reimbursed in full
